shared_elements: low-relief carved human figures in strict profile
bearded male figures with patterned hair/beard treatment
procession or file of figures moving in one direction
justification: Both surfaces show shallow relief friezes of bearded male figures in strict profile advancing in a single direction alongside horses, organized into horizontal registers with a stylized ground/plant motif, which is a fairly specific shared convention. The biggest difference in content is that A is a compact narrative action scene — a chariot with team, armed warriors and a marsh/water landscape — while B is a static repetitive procession of nearly identical standing figures leading animals, with no vehicle, weapons or landscape.
